metadata.description: Skills and agents for Claude Code and Codex that take a change from discussion to merge: a plan file, phases built by subagents, a review and an e2e check, then human approval.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Seven stages for every change: a grill or a discussion, an optional prototype, a plan file, phases built by implementer subagents, a review and an e2e check, a judge that lands the branch, a human approval, and finish. The session the user started coordinates and does not edit code. The pipeline keeps the product's rules in docs/spec/ itself: the grill reads them, the plan carries them, the build writes them. Skills and agents, one script for the spec, no hooks.
